Find a next step that fits your stage. On first launch, choose High school student, University student, Graduate applicant or beyond, or Parent for a tailored introduction and home page. Change roles later without losing saved items or notes.

TAIWAN: FREE TO EXPLORE
• 158 current institutions, 1,346 majors, 2,747 institution-specific programs and 1,338 learning maps
• A 10-question interest quiz, on-device suggestions, favorites, decision notes and comparisons of up to 4 items
• Taiwan graduate application routes and official admissions links

ALL US DATA REQUIRES PRO
US school search and directories, fields, courses, historical statistics, admissions, testing guides and costs require valid Pro access. Monthly and annual plans include the same undergraduate and graduate guidance.
• 4,031 institutions from IPEDS 2025, with state, control and study-level filters
• Historical degree awards, field classifications and selected course plans, with sources

US MASTER'S AND PhD PREPARATION
• Search 2,081 institutions reported as offering graduate education. This institutional flag does not establish every master's or PhD program or current admission.
• Separate master's and PhD routes for research interests, transcripts, SOP/CV, references and submission
• Checklists saved on your device, official admissions links, timeline planning and funding checks

TESTS BY STUDY LEVEL
Undergraduate SAT/ACT and graduate GRE/GMAT guides are separate, with shared English-test guidance. GMAT preparation concerns graduate business study. Check required tests, accepted alternatives and waivers with each target program; not every test is required.

PRO UNDERGRADUATE TOOLS
• Available 2026–27 Common App first-year requirements for 941 schools
• First-year, transfer and international checklists; local reminders only for dates you confirm
• Compare historical undergraduate costs for up to 4 schools in the same year and living situation. Missing values are not zero; these are not graduate costs.

LANGUAGES, PRIVACY AND SOURCES
20 interface languages; guides are mainly Traditional Chinese and English, and official sources retain their original language.
No login or tracking SDKs. Preferences and preparation stay on your device. Bundled data works offline; external sources and purchases/restores require internet access.
Data are dated snapshots, not a guarantee of current or complete program requirements. A directory listing does not confirm current admission, and historical scores are not minimum cutoffs. Not affiliated with schools; admission is never guaranteed. Check current official notices before applying.

SUBSCRIPTION
US Admissions Pro is offered as monthly and annual auto-renewing subscriptions with the same content. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Free features never require a subscription.

results.description:
Every connection has a story.

Coffee Chat Note is a private notebook for career conversations and professional relationships. Prepare for a coffee chat, capture what you learned and keep track of what comes next.

REMEMBER THE PEOPLE
Organize contacts, companies, roles, backgrounds and interaction history so your next conversation starts with context.

KEEP THE INSIGHTS
Write, edit, search and revisit your conversation notes, questions, takeaways and reflections.

FOLLOW THROUGH
Create follow-up tasks and local reminders, organize career opportunities and track your next steps.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR DATA
No app account is required. Your notebook is stored on your device, with complete JSON backup and restore plus data exports. Optionally protect app access with Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode. Shared files and backups may contain private information; keep them somewhere you trust.

PRO: MONTHLY OR YEARLY
Meeting briefs before every conversation, a monthly networking goal with streaks, business card scanning and contact import, a list of who to reconnect with, and four exclusive app icons with your Pro member card. Pro also includes 16 recommended conversation templates, 72 personalizable phrases and a 160-question bank, plus custom templates and fields, advanced filters and collections, contact cadences and workflows, PDF reports, an opportunity board, a career knowledge library, statistics, custom CSV and Markdown exports, a relationship map, and themes. The App Store purchase confirmation shows the applicable price, currency, billing period and any trial.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in your Apple Account settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. If a free trial is offered, the subscription starts automatically when the trial ends unless canceled at least 24 hours before it ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account after confirmation. Manage or cancel in Apple Account settings. After cancellation, Pro remains available until the paid period ends. Free notes, existing template answers, and complete backup and restore remain available afterward. Purchases, restoration and current store information may need a connection.

Available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, French, Korean, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Indonesian, Hindi and Arabic. Change the language and System, Light or Dark appearance inside Settings.

results.description:
Crypto Guide is a bilingual learning app for blockchain and cryptocurrency. Version 2.0 adds the Crypto Investment & Research Academy, taking you from your first lesson to doing your own investment research.

Intro courses for newcomers:

• Blockchain Foundations
Explore Bitcoin's origins, the Bitcoin white paper, blocks, nodes, consensus, wallets, smart contracts, Layer 2 networks, and real-world applications.

• Crypto Investing
Understand exchange types, fiat deposits and withdrawals, order types, long and short positions, leverage, risk management, and the differences between major crypto assets.

Crypto Investment & Research Academy (new in 2.0):

• 12 modules and 180 articles covering blockchain fundamentals, crypto markets, tokenomics and valuation, business strategy, onchain analytics, technical analysis, quantitative trading, derivatives, risk management, DeFi, research methods, and careers
• Every article includes a definition, how it works, applied examples, formulas, research relevance, common misconceptions, risks, and a three-question quiz
• 7 learning paths with ordered stages, prerequisites, practice tasks, checkpoints, and completion criteria
• A 12-month dual-track plan for personal investing (paper trading) and professional research, at 4, 7, or 10 hours a week
• 10 hands-on research projects built on public data
• Risk Lab calculators for position sizing, VaR, drawdowns, liquidation price, funding costs, impermanent loss, and dollar-cost averaging
• Academy term index: 700+ key terms with definitions and source articles

Learning tools:

• Learning goals: pick a goal and a weekly time budget, and the Courses tab and daily reminder follow your recommended path
• Mistake review: academy questions you miss return to Daily Review after 1, 3, 7, 14, and 30 days
• Global Search across terms, lessons, academy articles, exchanges, and asset categories
• Exchange Atlas and Asset Categories
• Bilingual: the interface and glossary are in English and Traditional Chinese, and all 12 Academy modules are fully available in English
• iCloud sync: academy progress follows your Apple Account across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• Widgets and reminders: one term or academy concept each day, opening straight to the lesson

Crypto Guide Pro (optional subscription; everything above stays free):

• Research workbench: highlights, notes, investment-thesis tracker with review reminders, Markdown/PDF export
• Advanced Risk Lab: portfolio volatility, VaR/ES, risk contributions, stress scenarios, Kelly fraction

results.description:
Practice with virtual cash in Stock Mastery. Stocks/guides are free; Pro unlocks new futures/options positions.

No deposits, broker connections or real orders. Apple bills Pro. Portfolios stay local, currencies stay separate and no app account is needed.

Free stock practice
• Taiwan: TWSE/TPEx end-of-day data, indices, breadth, rankings, valuation metrics, corporate-action dates and watchlists
• Taiwan paper fills at displayed closing or custom prices, plus pending limit orders
• U.S.: daily closes for all US-listed stocks/ETFs (public Nasdaq.com pages, can be turned off), virtual USD, fills at the close or your price
• U.S. holdings valued at the latest close; no real-time quotes or U.S. limit orders
• iPhone/iPad Taiwan background updates, controlled in Settings; iOS chooses timing/frequency, with no daily guarantee

Stock Mastery Pro: futures and options practice
• Taiwan TX, MTX, TMF, TE electronics and TF financial futures
• Micro S&P 500 (MES), Nasdaq-100 (MNQ), gold (MGC) and WTI crude oil (MCL) futures
• TXO calls/puts and standard U.S. stock/ETF options with 100 shares per contract
• Long/short positions, adding, partial/full closes and record export
• Enter practice expiry dates, strikes, fill prices, margin and fees
• For Taiwan positions, explicitly select a TAIFEX monthly/weekly contract to track its regular-session last traded price after the session, with source dates
• Overseas reference prices remain manual
• Separate virtual TWD/USD accounts share a real-time or custom practice clock

Tracking updates reference prices, not fills. Custom time pauses updates; they stop after practice expiry. Manual marks, adding or partial closes return the position to manual mode. Missing quotes retain the previous price/date; there is no settlement-price substitution or automatic contract rollover. Your expiry remains a practice setting; check the month and weekly series.

Advancing time does not load historical quotes, predict prices or change prices, cash or option time value. After trading, time cannot move backwards. Expired positions close manually.

Practice contracts are user-defined; entered prices are not executable quotes. No live options chain, exchange settlement, margin calls, forced liquidation, exercise, assignment or delivery. Adjusted U.S. contracts and U.S. index options are excluded. Futures require positive prices. Losses can exceed margin. Fees use your inputs and exclude transaction taxes.

Pro subscription
U.S. prices: US$0.99/month or US$9.99/year, billed annually in one payment. Both plans offer the same access. The App Store shows local prices before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled before the current period ends. Manage or cancel through your Apple Account; Restore Purchases is in the Pro screen.

Member Center shows the plan, access expiry and workspace entry. Free previews never buy or open positions. Pro is required for new derivatives positions; records, reference-price updates, closing and export remain available after access ends. Clearing local data does not cancel subscriptions.

Learn and personalize
Guides cover finance terms, ETFs, risk, scams and Taiwan securities qualifications. Choose System Default or 12 app languages: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Indonesian, Hindi and Arabic. Optional reminders run Monday-Friday at 6 PM device-local time, including holidays; they are not price/fill alerts. Widgets show Taiwan summaries and daily knowledge on a system schedule.

Data is end-of-day, may be delayed/incomplete and is not executable. No historical charts. Taiwan limit fills use later daily ranges, not trade replay. Legacy U.S. pending orders can only be cancelled. No personalized advice or guaranteed returns.

results.description:
Share seven days of little moments with a pig of your own.

Each generation lasts seven days. Feed your pig, take walks, chat and work. Discover five personalities and collect 100 story cards. Furnish your room and choose outfits from the wardrobe. The game includes coins and optional gem purchases through in-app purchases.

Meet other owners in Pig Friends, a dedicated main tab. Set an owner nickname and a separate pig name. Create your community identity directly in the app—no email, password or ChatGPT account required. Choose a public or private profile card.

Friend invitations require both people to agree. Leave messages on friends' boards or talk in private messages. After mutual declarations of affection and at least two dates, you can propose. Marriage begins only when the other person accepts. Random NPC romantic rivals add fictional events to your pigs' story; they are game characters, not real people.

Block unwanted interactions, report concerns or delete your community account in the app. Changing devices? If you are still signed in on the old app, generate a single-use pairing code that expires in five minutes to transfer your community identity.

Everyday pig care works offline. Community identities, friend invitations, boards, private messages and device pairing use cloud services and require an internet connection.

The main pig-raising game supports Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English and Japanese. Pig Friends is currently available in Traditional Chinese.

多條故事路線與分支選擇
可自由存檔、讀檔，方便回收不同結局

適合喜歡乙女遊戲、視覺小說與劇情向作品的玩家
如果你喜歡角色陪伴感、曖昧拉扯與慢慢升溫的劇情節奏，《賴瑞的調酒研究室》會是一段值得細細品味的故事旅程。

results.description:
Turn what matters into a plan you can act on today.

AI TimeManager brings tasks, daily planning, focus sessions and reflection together in one app.

TASKS AND PROJECTS
Capture tasks with notes, estimates, priorities and due dates. Organize them by project and create daily, weekday or weekly repeating tasks.

DAILY PLANNING
See your timeline and available capacity. Schedule work manually or preview an automatic arrangement before applying it. Existing reservations are respected.

FOCUS WITH FLEXIBILITY
Start a 15, 25 or 45-minute session, or begin from a task or scheduled block. When time ends, choose to complete, extend, take a break or skip. Breaks are excluded from focused time.

SMART SUGGESTIONS AND SAVED WORKFLOWS
Get editable steps and thinking prompts for your goal. Suggestions use on-device keyword rules and curated templates. They do not call generative AI services or upload your task text. Save workflows for quick reuse.

REFLECTION AND BACKUP
Review actual focused time, completion and recent trends. Record energy and interruptions. Manually export and import JSON backups containing tasks, schedules, workflows and focus history.

WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
Access focus actions from Home Screen widgets and App Shortcuts. Compatible iPhones also support Live Activities.

Supports Traditional Chinese and English, light and dark appearance, iPhone, iPad and Mac. No account, advertising or tracking. Data stays on your device, and reminders are optional.

results.description:
Dreams can fade within minutes of waking. Dream Keepsake gives you a quiet place to save an image, a sentence or a feeling. Your first note does not need to be complete.

Capture and revisit for free
• Text and optional voice input, with draft autosave
• Moods, clarity, tags and favorites
• On-device, rule-based reflections, questions and research sources
• Search, edit, delete, dream calendar and basic trend review
• Daily local reminders, with no app account required

Optional Pro: My Dream Atlas
• Bring together themes, recorded emotions and source entries across your saved journal, connecting your latest dream with earlier clues
• Write your own meanings in a personal dream dictionary; search, edit or delete them. These are your words, not facts inferred by the app
• Revisit months that contain entries and compare recent 30-day recording activity with the preceding 30 days
• Complete a 20-item self-report questionnaire based on Mini-IPIP to view a five-axis trait radar. Each score is an item mean from 1 to 5, not a population percentile or personality type
• After answering all items and confirming, preview and share a trait card. It contains no dream text, mood records or dictionary notes
• Explore a clearly labeled example before subscribing

Room for your own interpretation
Reports organize saved tags and records on your device without cloud AI. Recording counts do not measure sleep quality or establish mental states or dream causes. The questionnaire supports self-reflection; non-English items are app translations that have not been independently validated. Reflections and trait scores do not provide medical or psychological diagnosis.

Privacy and control
Dreams, drafts, questionnaire answers and dictionary notes stay on your device. There are no ads or third-party analytics. Voice input runs only when you start it; Apple speech services may process audio depending on device and language support. Deleting a dream updates derived reports; your dictionary notes remain until separately deleted. After a subscription ends, free features remain available, and you can still read or delete dictionary notes and clear questionnaire answers.

Pro subscriptions
Monthly and yearly plans unlock the same Pro features. The purchase screen shows the price and period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account; subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in Apple subscription settings, or restore purchases in the app. No free trial is offered.

For iPhone and iPad, in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, German, Spanish and Korean.

設計以溫柔的莫蘭迪色系為主視覺，乾淨、柔和、不刺眼，讓你專注在真正重要的事情——誰會是這一輪的幸運得主！

Build a personal research library with PDFs, images, photos and document scans. Paper Reading Desk keeps originals and notes on your device, extracts text locally, and suggests keywords and theories you can edit or leave blank.

• Read original documents beside your notes in a wide iPad window; switch views in a narrow window.
• Review a rule-based reading breakdown of purpose, sample, methods, findings and limitations, with source-page links when page information is available.
• Choose a supported translation language and compare each translated paragraph with its source.
• Write your own notes and edit keywords, theories, tags and bibliographic details.
• Search extracted text and notes, copy APA/MLA/BibTeX/RIS citations, and optionally retrieve metadata by DOI.
• Export a full library backup, or a separate portable copy of your notes and bibliography.

No account, AI account or API key is required; reading, organizing and the breakdown run on the device. This version has no cloud AI analysis or in-app purchases.

In-app paragraph translation requires iOS/iPadOS 18 or later; 17.4–17.x uses the system translation panel and 17.0–17.3 does not offer translation. The native Mac app requires macOS 15.5 or later. Language availability depends on the device and OS, and the first language download needs internet access. Scanned-PDF OCR covers up to the first 32 pages while preserving the complete original. Translation and the breakdown are reading aids: check the source before quoting. Full backups use .paperbackup. Notes JSON excludes originals and is not a restorable full backup. Restore adds new papers only and is not cross-device synchronization. Exported files are not encrypted; keep them secure.

results.description:
Want to fly on miles but not sure which airline, which card, or whether to just buy the miles?

MileButler puts published award charts, the cost of buying miles and Taiwan credit-card transfer terms in one place. Choose your origin, destination, cabin and dates to compare:

• Miles needed across 9 calculable programs, including EVA Air, China Airlines, STARLUX, JAL and ANA
• What buying the miles would cost (including an overseas card fee estimate), or a link to the official quote
• Which credit card to use, how much to spend and roughly how many months it takes
• Your existing miles and bank points are subtracted, so you only see what is still missing
• 125 Taiwan credit cards with transfer ratios, minimums and annual fees
• Ticket rules: one-way, stopovers, changes and refunds
• Compare 2–4 options side by side on iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Home Screen widget for your goal progress
• 20 languages, switchable in the app

MileButler Pro
• Redeem Now: award tickets you can book now, after a points transfer, or are close to
• Unlimited mileage goals with estimated completion dates
• Multi-card plan: use points from every bank first, then the fastest card for the rest
• Expiry and booking-window alerts: 90 and 30 days before miles expire; when award seats open for your date
• Miles portfolio with balance history
• Advanced widgets, iCloud sync, CSV export and full backups

Pro is an auto-renewing subscription with monthly and yearly plans. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://victoriac1122.github.io/milebutler-support/#privacy-policy

All data comes from airlines’ and card issuers’ public information; the app collects no personal data. Award availability, taxes, dynamic pricing, transfer ratios and promotions are set by the airlines and issuers. The app does not book, issue or sell tickets.

results.description:
Plan a room without learning drafting software first. Build It Yourself brings room previews, room-photo recoloring, material choices, and budget planning together, so you can turn an idea into a plan to discuss with family or a designer.

• Start with a living room, bedroom, or workspace template. Change floors, walls, furniture, lighting, layouts, and camera views.
• Add a room reference photo, move or rotate furniture, save the layout, and use dimensioned sample storage models.
• View the photo's dominant colors and brightness on-device. Manually select a four-corner area, recolor it, compare Original and Result, and export the study.
• Optionally scan with RoomPlan on supported LiDAR iPhone or iPad hardware; other devices retain sample spaces and photo features.
• Save materials, organize quantities, delivery and installation estimates, and share an itemized breakdown.
• 3D Plan: draw floor plans and arrange furniture with the official Sweet Home 3D online editor inside the app, then switch between 2D and 3D (internet required).
• A Home Screen widget opens your favorite feature in one tap and shows a daily design tip.
• Available in 20 languages, switchable in the app. No account is required and core features work offline.

Photo recoloring uses manual selection and local pixel processing. It does not provide AI photorealistic remodeling, automatic furniture recognition, automatic wall segmentation, or measured illuminance. Photos, scans, and layouts stay on the device and are not uploaded automatically. Sweet Home 3D is a third-party online service; it manages its own accounts and online designs under its privacy policy.

Materials, suppliers, prices, and storage models are bundled examples. Visuals, scans, and estimates are for early planning, not construction drawings or a contractor's final quote. Dimension notes do not resize the 3D room or calculate quantities. Confirm dimensions, methods, and costs with a qualified professional.

Privacy policy and support: https://victoriac1122.github.io/design-it-yourself-privacy-policy/

results.description:
給剛開始學半導體的人。每天花5分鐘，看圖讀一小段，慢慢把晶片和產業搞懂。

學生、想轉職的人，或剛進半導體公司做非工程職的新人，都不需要先有背景。挑一個主題，看圖解和短短的說明，再用小實驗、測驗和術語卡確認自己真的懂了。

課程
• 24堂入門課，內容包含半導體原理、晶片種類、IC設計和晶圓製造。
• 每課有解說、比喻、實際例子和相關術語，最後3題測驗，總共72題。
• 可以一步步看IC設計流程：規格、設計、驗證到實體實作。

互動實驗
• 拖動閘極電壓，看電晶體的通道怎麼打開；也能直接切換開／關。
• 晶片圖鑑有CPU、GPU、NPU、DRAM、NAND、MCU、SoC 7種，可以切換比較構造和用途。
• 對照平面、FinFET、GAA三種電晶體結構，以及打線和倒裝銅柱兩種封裝方式。
• 晶圓製程分6個階段：晶圓、薄膜、圖案化、元件、金屬互連、封裝，可以打開前後對照，看每一步改了什麼。
• 光阻、曝光、顯影、蝕刻、去光阻，用剖面圖走一輪。
• 調整晶粒面積和缺陷密度，看簡化的良率模型怎麼變。
• 點產業裡的各個角色，看設計、製造、設備、材料、封測怎麼分工。

術語
• 153個術語，可以搜尋、分類、收藏，英文原文也保留著。
• 術語翻卡依分類抽，一輪最多10張。先自己想，再翻開看解釋，標「已記住」或「再複習」，沒記住的可以再練。
• 翻卡的自評只在這一輪有效，不會算進測驗成績。

公司與學習地圖
• 21家公司檔案：主要產品、技術、商業模式，還有值得注意的地方。
• 半導體學習地圖（只有繁體中文）：入門影片、書單、76家公司簡介、各職位要學什麼、全球產業佈局，以及非本科的進修管道。
• 學習進度、課程筆記、測驗紀錄都存在這台裝置上，可以回頭重做錯題。
• 課程和公司資料都附上來源和查核日期。

免費和Pro
現有的入門課程、基礎圖解、公司檔案、術語字典、測驗和學習紀錄都免費。Pro是選購的自動續訂訂閱，多兩個工具：兩家公司的商業模式並排比較，以及兩組良率與成本假設的情境比較。月訂閱和年訂閱的功能一樣，訂閱期間都能用Pro工具。

購買前會先顯示Pro的價格和期間，由Apple帳號付款。訂閱會自動續訂，除非在當期結束前至少24小時取消；可以到Apple的訂閱管理取消。目前沒有免費試用。

20種語言
在「我的 > App 語言」選語言，或跟著系統。介面、所有課程、測驗、公司介紹和術語字典都有20種語言：繁體中文、簡體中文、英文、日文、法文、西班牙文、德文、韓文、葡萄牙文、俄文、阿拉伯文、印地文、孟加拉文、烏爾都文、印尼文、越南文、土耳其文、泰米爾文、泰盧固文、馬拉地文。學習地圖目前只有繁體中文。

各語言的教材都內建在App裡，離線也能讀，不用即時翻譯。換語言不會影響學習進度、收藏、測驗紀錄和筆記；自己寫的筆記不會被翻譯。英文課名和技術名詞會保留對照，外部資料來源維持原文。譯文是從繁體中文原稿機器翻譯，再檢查過技術用詞。

其他
課程和學習紀錄離線可用；打開外部資料來源、讀取訂閱方案、購買和恢復購買時需要網路。不用註冊帳號，沒有廣告，學習紀錄不會跨裝置同步。

圖解和良率計算都是標明假設的教學模型，不代表任何公司的真實製程、良率或報價。公司資料和學習地圖裡的股價、市值是為了理解產業，不是投資建議。
